macros.name: listingscaption
macros.doc: This allows the string “Listing” in a listing’s caption to be customized.

macros.name: listoflistings
macros.doc: Used to produce a list of listings (like \listoffigures etc.).

macros.name: listoflistingscaption
macros.doc: This allows the caption of the listings list, “List of Listings,” to be customized.

macros.name: MintedRegisterTempFileExtension
macros.doc: Additional file extensions can be registered with \MintedRegisterTempFileExtension{〈ext〉}, where 〈ext〉 is the literal file extension (no macros) including the leading period (for example, “.tmp”).

macros.name: newmintedfile
macros.doc: Define a new language-specific alias for \inputminted.
